text: Provides sandbox merchant accounts and test cards to simulate payment scenarios including 3D Secure flows
quote: SumUp provides sandbox merchant accounts and a comprehensive set of test cards to simulate various payment scenarios, including different 3D Secure authentication flows.

text: Lets developers test pairing and checkout flow with a Virtual Solo reader before switching to a physical reader
quote: Use Virtual Solo together with a sandbox merchant account to test the pairing and checkout flow first, then switch to a physical reader later

text: Gives coding assistants current SumUp documentation and tools to reference
quote: Give coding assistants current SumUp documentation and tools.

text: Documentation is available as plain-text Markdown by appending index.md to any doc URL
quote: You can access all of our documentation as plain text Markdown files by adding index.md to the end of any URL.

text: Runs a managed MCP server letting MCP clients manage the account, create checkouts, and process payments
quote: SumUp runs a managed MCP server at https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp. This endpoint allows your MCP client to interact with SumUp APIs to manage your account, create checkouts, or process payments

text: Provides an Agent Toolkit adding SumUp API tools to agent frameworks like LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and MCP
quote: The SumUp Agent Toolkit adds SumUp API tools to agentic applications built with LangChain, AI SDK, the OpenAI Agents SDK, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

text: Ships an official @sumup/sdk npm package with TypeScript types for modern JS runtimes
quote: The @sumup/sdk package wraps SumUp API, ships TypeScript declarations, and works in modern JavaScript runtimes and platforms

text: API keys act as static credentials letting an application act on behalf of a merchant account
quote: API keys are static credentials that let your application act on behalf of the merchant account that created the key.

text: API requests authenticate using a Bearer token in the Authorization header
quote: Include the API key in the `Authorization` header using the `Bearer` scheme when calling SumUp APIs.

text: Notifies integrators when a checkout's status changes
quote: At this time our system only allows you to get notified about a status change for a checkout.

text: Supports full or partial refunds of previously processed payments
quote: When you complete these steps, the payment you have previously processed through SumUp will be refunded either partially or in full.

text: Offers three integration paths for in-person payments: Cloud API, Reader SDKs, and Payment Switch
quote: There are three ways to integrate SumUp in-person payments: | | Cloud API | Reader SDKs | Payment Switch |

text: Cloud API triggers and manages payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests from a backend
quote: Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.

text: Supports simultaneous transactions across multiple Solo card readers with no distance limitation
quote: Ability to process simultaneous transactions on multiple Solo card readers at once - No distance limitation between your POS device and the Solo card reader

text: Multiple Solo card readers can be paired to any SumUp account
quote: Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account

text: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without a separate reader
quote: Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.

text: Offline Transactions let merchants keep accepting card payments when internet connectivity is unavailable
quote: Offline Transactions let merchants continue accepting card payments when internet connectivity is unavailable or unreliable.

text: Compares hosted, embedded, web, and mobile checkout integration options
quote: Compare hosted, embedded, web, and mobile checkout options.

text: Lets developers embed payment acceptance directly into their own Android or iOS apps
quote: Embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app.

text: Documents the methods available for merchant and checkout API resources
quote: Discover the methods available to a merchant and checkout.

text: In-person payment products accept card payments face-to-face via physical readers or Tap to Pay
quote: SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.
